title: Extraction of RNA from Wastewater Primary Solids for SARS-CoV-2 RNA Quantification
author: Stephanie Loeb
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bi6skhee
materials: One 2g aliquot can be place directly into a 15 mL PowerBead tubes from RNeasy PowerSoil Total RNA extraction kit to prepare for extraction. Depending on the number of replicates required, additional aliquots can also be placed in PowerBead tubes for extraction. RNeasy® PowerSoil® Total RNA Kit Qiagen Catalog #12866-25

steps.title: Load primary sludge into rotor
steps.instruction: Load up to 40 mL of primary sludge into the centrifuge rotor, balancing each tube with an equally weighted water‑filled tube.

steps.title: Pre‑run preparation
steps.instruction: Day before processing, thaw sludge overnight at 4 °C and record weight and volume. On the day of processing, place aluminum weigh dishes in an oven for 1 h, set centrifuge temperature to 4 °C and allow it to equilibrate for 30 min before use.

steps.title: Centrifuge primary solids
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the sludge at 14 500 rpm (≈24 000 × g) at 4 °C for 30 min. Bring the rotor into the biosafety cabinet (BSC) before loading or opening the tube.

steps.title: Decant supernatant
steps.instruction: Decant the supernatant into an empty 50 mL Falcon tube (or larger). Record the weight and volume of the remaining solids and discard the liquid as biohazard waste.

steps.title: Measure percent solids
steps.instruction: Transfer ~500 mg of the solid fraction onto a pre‑weighed aluminum weigh dish taken directly from the oven (do not allow to rehydrate). Record the total weight before covering with aluminum and place the dish in the oven to dry according to EPA Method 106.3. If <2 g of solids are available, use a smaller aliquot.

steps.title: Aliquot solids for extraction
steps.instruction: Aliquot 2.0–2.5 g of the solids into tarred or pre‑weighed tubes using a sterile spatula, noting the exact mass.

steps.title: Spike with BCoV control
steps.instruction: Add 20 µL of BCoV stock (Bovilis Coronavirus Calf Vaccine, Merck Animal Health, Catalog #16445) to each 15 mL PowerBead tube, pipetting directly into the solids and mixing thoroughly with a spatula. Equilibrate the spiked samples at 4 °C for 1 h. Rehydrate BCoV vaccine with molecular‑grade water before use; store rehydrated solution at 4 °C. Prepare a known dilution of the BCoV stock in PBS for concentration verification.

steps.title: Store spiked samples
steps.instruction: Store the spiked PowerBead tubes at –80 °C. Archive duplicate aliquots in cryovials at –80 °C.

steps.title: Prepare extraction workspace
steps.instruction: Set up a sterile RNase‑free workspace in a BSC. Heat Solution IRS to 60 °C until any precipitate dissolves. Wear RNase‑free gloves and remove RNase from the area. All processing must stay in the BSC until bead‑beating is completed; after bead‑beating the samples are considered non‑infectious.

steps.title: Thaw samples on ice
steps.instruction: Remove frozen PowerBead tubes from the –80 °C freezer, place them on ice (no thawing required), and keep Solution IRS warm for immediate use.

steps.title: Add lysis reagents
steps.instruction: To each PowerBead tube add 2.5 mL PowerBead Solution, 0.25 mL Solution SR1, and 0.8 mL warm Solution IRS. Vortex vigorously to suspend solids. If the sample is not already in a PowerBead tube, perform this addition in the original tube, then transfer the entire mixture to a PowerBead tube before the next step. If large residual solids remain after vortexing, perform two washes of 1.75 mL phenol/chloroform/isoamyl alcohol (pH 6.5–8.0) each; rinse any disposable spatula in the same solution.

steps.title: Vortex to clear biphasic layer
steps.instruction: Cap the PowerBead tube and vortex until the biphasic layer disappears. Place the tube on a vortex adapter and vortex at maximum speed for 15 min (00:15:00).

steps.title: Centrifuge lysate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the PowerBead tube at 2 500 × g, room temperature, for 10 min (00:10:00). After centrifugation, the upper aqueous phase contains total nucleic acids.

steps.title: Collect aqueous phase
steps.instruction: Transfer the upper aqueous phase to a clean 15 mL collection tube, avoiding any material from the lower phases. Discard the remaining phases as BSL‑2 waste.

steps.title: Add Solution SR3 and spin
steps.instruction: Add 1.5 mL Solution SR3 to the aqueous phase, vortex to mix, incubate at 4 °C for 10 min (00:10:00), then centrifuge at 2 500 × g, room temperature, for 10 min (00:10:00).

steps.title: Transfer supernatant
steps.instruction: Carefully transfer the supernatant (without disturbing the pellet) to a new 15 mL collection tube.

steps.title: Precipitate nucleic acids
steps.instruction: Add 5 mL Solution SR4 to the supernatant, invert or vortex to mix, then incubate at –20 °C for 30 min (00:30:00) or overnight if continuation the next day.

steps.title: Centrifuge precipitation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 2 500 × g for 30 min (00:30:00).

steps.title: Decant supernatant
steps.instruction: Decant the supernatant and invert the 15 mL collection tube on a paper towel for 5 min (00:05:00). Verify that the pellet is firmly attached to the tube bottom before discarding the supernatant.

steps.title: Resuspend pellet with SR5
steps.instruction: Shake Solution SR5 to mix, add 1 mL to the tube, and resuspend the pellet by repeated pipetting or vortexing. Place the tube in a 45 °C heat block or water bath for 10 min (00:10:00), vortex/pipette, and repeat until the pellet is fully resuspended, yielding an opaque cloudy yellow‑white solution with no visible precipitates.

steps.title: Prepare JetStar Mini Column
steps.instruction: For each sample, remove the cap of a provided 15 mL collection tube and insert a JetStar Mini Column so that it hangs inside the tube.

steps.title: Load sample onto column
steps.instruction: Add the RNA isolation sample (the eluate from the previous steps) onto the JetStar Mini Column and allow gravity flow into the 15 mL collection tube. Flow may be slow; if it exceeds 1 h, apply gentle positive pressure with a syringe plunger. Do not exceed a flow rate of >1 drop per second.

steps.title: Wash column with SR5
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL Solution SR5 to the column, allow gravity flow into the collection tube, and apply gentle positive pressure if flow stalls. Maintain the ≤1 drop / s flow limit.

steps.title: Elute RNA with SR6
steps.instruction: Transfer the column to a new 15 mL collection tube, shake Solution SR6 to mix, add 1 mL SR6 to the column, and allow gravity flow to elute bound RNA. Apply gentle pressure if needed, keeping flow ≤1 drop / s.

steps.title: Second‑stage cleanup
steps.instruction: Transfer the eluate to a 2.2 mL collection tube, add 1 mL Solution SR4, invert at least once, and incubate at 20 °C for ≥10 min (00:10:00) or at –20 °C overnight if desired.

steps.title: Pellet RNA
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the 2.2 mL tube at 13 000 × g, room temperature, for 15 min (00:15:00) to pellet the RNA.

steps.title: Air‑dry RNA pellet
steps.instruction: Decant the supernatant, then invert the tube on a paper towel for 30 min (00:30:00) to air‑dry the RNA pellet.

steps.title: Resuspend RNA
steps.instruction: Resuspend the RNA pellet in 100 µL Solution SR7. Ensure the pellet is fully dissolved; the solution should be clear and flow smoothly without material adhering to the tube walls.

steps.title: Remove PCR inhibitors
steps.instruction: Process the RNA using Zymo OneStep PCR Inhibitor Removal Columns (Zymo Research Catalog #D6030) to eliminate co‑concentrated inhibitors.

steps.title: Centrifuge inhibitor columns
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the columns at 8 000 × g for 3 min (00:03:00).

steps.title: Collect flow‑through
steps.instruction: Discard the flow‑through tube and place each column into a labeled 1.5 mL LoBind tube.

steps.title: Bind RNA to column
steps.instruction: Add the full 100 µL RNA/DNA extract to each column.

steps.title: Final spin‑down
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the LoBind tubes with columns at 16 000 × g for 3 min (00:03:00).

steps.title: Downstream applications
steps.instruction: The purified RNA can be used immediately for cDNA synthesis, one‑step PCR, ddPCR, or qPCR. Perform Nanodrop and/or Qubit quantification, and/or reverse transcription as needed, or store the eluate at –80 °C for later use.

steps.title: Store extra aliquots
steps.instruction: Place additional 2 g aliquots of the original sample into as many 5 mL cryovials as possible and store at –80 °C.

steps.title: Add phenol‑chloroform
steps.instruction: Add 3.5 mL phenol/chloroform/isoamyl alcohol (pH 6.5–8.0, UltraPure™ 25:24:1, Thermo Fisher Catalog #15593031) to the sample tube and vortex vigorously.

steps.title: Wash column with SR5
steps.instruction: Add 2 mL Solution SR5 to the JetStar Mini Column, allow gravity flow into the 15 mL collection tube, and do not let the column dry before the next step.

steps.title: Prep column with solution
steps.instruction: Place one JetStar Mini Column into a fresh 15 mL collection tube for each sample and add 600 µL Prep solution to the column.
